title: Sign in to In Falcone Console
subtitle: Authentication backed by Keycloak, the same identity layer that protects the rest of the platform.
usernameHelp: Use the console username associated with your organization.
passwordHelp: The password policy is validated by the access service.
credentialTitle: We could not validate your credentials
credentialMessage: Check your username and password and try again.
deniedMessage: These credentials do not grant access to the console. Check your username and password and try again.
loginErrorTitle: The access service is currently unavailable
loginErrorMessage: An operational error occurred. You can retry shortly without reloading the console.
networkTitle: Could not connect to the access service
networkMessage: Check your connection and try again.
policyErrorTitle: Could not read the signup policy
policyErrorMessage: You can retry the policy read without interrupting sign-in.
statusErrorTitle: Could not read the account status
statusErrorMessage: You can retry the status read without sending your credentials again.
statusDeniedTitle: Account status is not available for consultation
policyDeniedMessage: You do not have permission to read the signup policy. You can still use the sign-in form.
policyMissingMessage: We could not find the signup policy. You can still use the sign-in form.
asideDescription: The console checks the effective signup policy and, if your session expires, returns you to your protected destination after you sign in again.
invitationOnly: Signup in this environment is available by invitation only.
sessionProtection: Your session stays protected while navigating: if your destination required sign-in, you will return to it automatically after signing in.
contextBoth: Signup will preserve organization {tenantId} and workspace {workspaceId}.
contextWorkspace: Signup will preserve workspace {workspaceId}; review the organization before submitting your registration.

labels.rememberMe: Keep me signed in on this device
labels.signup: Request access or create your account
labels.signupDisabled: Self-service signup is currently unavailable for this environment.

password_recovery.message: Request recovery instructions to access the console again.
